displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump or 24VNA9 air conditioner. Short flashes, then long flashes. Code 53 is 5 short flashes and 3 long flashes
causes: Sensor harness not connected to the AOC control
Hardware damage to the AOC control
diySteps: A failed outdoor air thermistor changes defrost: the manual says defrost is then initiated from coil temperature and time
Technician: confirm the plug on the AOC, check harness continuity against the resistance chart, and replace the AOC if the control hardware is damaged
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Code 53 is a sensor circuit. Do not add refrigerant to make a heat pump heat.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
